governance.attested_by: nyiso-75 session 2026-07-26: the nyiso-72 keeper recipe re-solved across 2023-2025 with ZERO ScenarioConfig delta — the ONLY change is a CODE fix landed on main as PR #2903 (af74927): the shaped-solar fallback in data/renewables.py::_donor_shaped_distribution. EIA-930 files NYIS 'NG: SUN' as all zeros, so NYISO solar fell through to the EIA-930 distribution parquet, whose NYISO solar row was ONE repeated value over all 8760 hours — a flat, physically impossible solar day (sun at midnight). The fallback now detects ANY degenerate row (keyed on a distinct-value test, NOT on an ISO name) and repairs it from an adjacent same-clock BA (NEISO, verified local-clock, diurnal centroid h13.1) scaled by a clear-sky plane-of-array RATIO correcting the two fleets' EIA-860 tracking mixes. Level is UNTOUCHED (the shape sums to 1.0; mean CF exactly 0.1500; zero clipped hours) and the repair introduces ZERO new free parameters — verified mechanically, not asserted: rebuilding the DOF ledger with scripts/build_dof_ledger.py from the nyiso-72 run_config and from the nyiso-75 run_config yields BYTE-IDENTICAL output (7 auto-derived entries, 6 residual, zero differing fields). The only run_config differences between the two bundles are provenance (git sha/branch/timestamp) plus six ScenarioConfig fields that did not exist at cdb4ab4 and default to False (all inert for NYISO). VALIDATION against a series never used to build the repair — EIA-923 monthly netgen: flat row MAE 0.0304 / r -0.043 -> donor-only 0.0076 / 0.977 -> shipped (donor x POA ratio) 0.0050 / 0.983. A sweep across six ISOs x {wind, solar} x 2023-2025 proved NYISO solar was the ONLY live degenerate fallback cell; the other 30 ISO-year-mode cells are byte-identical pre/post.
governance.note: Rule 13 [R-MEASURED] admissibility: the repair is a reproducible PHYSICAL input, not an answer. The donor is a measured neighbouring-BA generation series and the correction is a clear-sky geometric POA ratio from the two fleets' published EIA-860 tracking mixes — both regenerate for a forward year and both respond to changed conditions (fleet mix, clock, weather year). Nothing is pinned to a NYISO outcome: the EIA-923 comparison above was used ONLY to validate after the fact, never to fit. No offset, haircut or scalar was tuned to any residual (rules 5 [R-NO-MAGIC] / 24 [R-REGISTRY]). The fix is ISO-agnostic by construction (degeneracy test, not an ISO branch), so it carries no rule-25 [R-ISO-SCOPE] cross-ISO tuning. It is LIVE in the codebase and therefore also changes NYISO solar in FORECAST mode — which is the point: keeper nyiso-72 was solved on the flat row and is no longer reproducible from current code. A phase-aligned clear-sky roll was BUILT, TESTED and REJECTED as the donor alternative: it applies _clearsky_geometry absolutely (which that helper's own docstring forbids — the omitted longitude/EoT term cancels only in a RATIO) and mis-times the shoulders (zero at h05-06, inflated at h19).
governance.residuals_note: SCORED EFFECT — one C1 cell flips PASS->FAIL: 2024 ST_GAS -3.021 TWh against a +/-3.01 TWh band (C1 all 14/14 -> 13/14, free 10/10 -> 9/10). THIS IS NOT CAUSED BY THE SOLAR FIX and is not attested as one. Measured: the fix moved model ST_GAS by only -0.056 TWh (8.106 -> 8.050, 0.7% of the class), and nyiso-72 was ALREADY at -2.965, i.e. 0.045 TWh — 1.5% of the band — inside the edge. Both bundles resolve the SAME benchmark hash eia923-465c3e2cf4a5; the full 2024 per-class delta is ST_GAS -0.056 / CC_REGULAR +0.079 / import -0.047 TWh. The cell is a KNIFE-EDGE crossing of a large PRE-EXISTING model miss, not a new one: NYISO ST_GAS under-generates by -1.83 / -3.02 / -5.12 TWh across 2023/2024/2025 and the gap GROWS every year. Note the 2025 cell — the worst by far, -5.12 TWh and -3.7pp share — is SKIPPED, not passed: the 2025 EIA-923 vintage is preliminary (3/10 ST_GAS plants reporting), so C1's PASS on nyiso-72 rested on 2023+2024 only and was already due to break as the 2025 benchmark matures. ROOT CAUSE IS DIAGNOSED AND OPEN, NOT UNKNOWN: results/calibration/FINDING-nyiso-stgas-underrun-diagnosis-2026-07-23.md establishes the under-run is a Long Island / NYC in-city LOAD-POCKET MUST-RUN gap, NOT an economic error — the ST_GAS heat rate is byte-identical to the EIA-860 design HR (and matches the CEMS operating HR), and the model already prices the LI load pocket ABOVE the steam's marginal cost ($47 evening vs mc $45-51), so no price or heat-rate correction can add the missing volume. The reliability floor is PINNED from both sides (down breaks C1 — nyiso-71, rejected; up worsens C7 diurnal shape 0.483 -> 0.422 and pushes further over the C8 cap, empirically probed). Per rules 5/13/23 the gap is NOT closed here: raising the floor to the observed volume would be a residual-fit to the bench. The only structurally-honest lever is a NEW measured-input mechanism driven by a published NYISO Zone-J/Zone-K minimum in-city generation REQUIREMENT — a dataset not in the repo, requiring its own charter and intake. NO tuning of any kind was performed in this session (rule 1 [R-STRUCT]): the structurally-correct solar repair stays in even though it moved a load-bearing criterion the wrong way. Determination is NOT-YET either way — C3a/C3b/C3c FAIL in both bundles independently of C1. 2022/2019/H1-2026 holdouts NOT touched (NYISO carries no calibration-complete marker, rule 22).

_open_items: (1) NEW, THE DOMINANT OPEN ITEM: the NYISO ST_GAS load-pocket must-run gap (-1.83/-3.02/-5.12 TWh, growing) now costs a scored C1 2024 cell and will cost 2025 once that EIA-923 vintage finalizes. Diagnosed in FINDING-nyiso-stgas-underrun-diagnosis-2026-07-23.md; economic and heat-rate causes are RULED OUT and the reliability floor is pinned from both sides. Forward lever: intake a published NYISO Zone-J / Zone-K minimum in-city generation requirement and build a grounded local-reliability commitment mechanism (rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH]: it must REPLACE or reconcile with the existing reliability_floor, never stack on it). Needs its own charter. (2) DOF-ledger completeness gap surfaced by this session and carried forward HONESTLY: rebuilding the ledger from run_config shows NYISO_LOCAL_SELFSUPPLY_FRAC['Long_Island'] = 0.45 (engaged via nyiso_local_selfsupply=True, residual-identified, audit C-17 / B-NYI-1) was MISSING from the nyiso-72 curated ledger. It is a PRE-EXISTING unledgered parameter, NOT a DOF added by the solar fix — the two configs rebuild byte-identically. It is now ledgered, so n_residual reads 6 (was reported as 5), n_entries 16. audit_keepers E8 checks root-cause presence on listed residuals, not ledger COMPLETENESS; consider extending it. (3) The margin form DEGRADES in-sample C3b in ALL THREE years (charter refutation not met); kept on the 2026-07-23 owner override for structural fidelity, NOT because it improves the fit. Its out-of-sample generalization claim remains THE open validation item and cannot be checked until NYISO earns a calibration-complete marker (rule 22). (4) The 2023 C3a energy-LEVEL residual (+17.9%) is unchanged in character and is NOT an offer-form problem (candidate levers: CC/ST offer-surface level, Transco/Iroquois gas basis, neighbor import pricing). (5) All nyiso-70 open items carry forward unchanged (East-side Blenheim-Gilboa PS reserve; the C7 ST_GAS 2023 off-peak shape). (6) No offer_curve_by_group residual re-tune taken (rule 22). (7) LATENT, NOT SHIPPED: the same sweep found MISO and SPP solar rows in data/raw/eia-930/eia_generation_profiles.parquet are UTC-stamped (diurnal centroid h18.5 / h19.4 vs h12.6-13.9 for correctly-clocked ISOs, ~+6h rotated). Latent because those cells take the per-BA hourly path, but any ISO-year that lost its hourly extract would silently inherit a six-hour-rotated solar day; the new guard detects FLATNESS, not ROTATION. 'solar_proxy' in the same file is DEAD DATA (zero code references) and is itself rotated (h17.3). Fixing this re-derives immutable data/raw and touches other ISOs, so it needs owner sign-off and its own validation. The NEISO donor used by the shipped fix is verified local-clock, so nothing shipped inherits the rotation.

entries.name: nyiso_scr_edrp
entries.note: NYISO SCR/EDRP emergency demand response as endogenous per-zone price-responsive supply blocks. Capacity = Gold-Book-registered SCR+EDRP MW per model zone (2023/24/25 summer 1.23/1.29/1.49 GW, scripts/data/build_nyiso_scr_edrp.py, byte-identical to the transcribed enrollment CSV). Strike = the published NYISO EDRP $500/MWh compensation floor (Market Services Tariff §5.12) — a market-design constant, NOT a residual. Clears the energy balance only when the zone LBMP exceeds the strike (endogenous scarcity trigger, never pinned to observed event dates; rule 13/17). ZERO fitted values; re-derives for a forward year from the next Gold Book (rule 23). Excluded from generation-mix scoring (avoided load, not generation).
